baseline_commit_message: Tranche Z — corrected-scope sonic-rs parity audit; landed: single-walk recognizer mining, SWAR fractional fix, cumulative ghost-variant deletion
description: Baseline captured after Tranche Z. Tranche Z executed against a corrected scope: the original draft mis-framed three of its phases (Z.1/Z.3/Z.4) and Z.5 as deeper refactors than they actually warranted. A second-pass audit (rebased on direct cargo-expand + grep against the source) revealed (a) the JSON `coerce_branch` boxing audit's '4 allocs/element' was wrong — Span is already inline in the enum variant, and the residual ~1 alloc/pair lives in the BoxedEnum→Alloc tuple-position decision in `decisions::child_alloc:40`, which would require a multi-pass type-system refactor to eliminate; (b) the inline.rs CSP for Ref already exists and is Rust-backend-local but TS/WASM don't use DriverState, so 'lifting' it has no cross-backend payoff; (c) `CallStrategy::InlineFusion` and `WrapMode::DelimScan` are both ghost variants — defined and pattern-matched in 2-3 consumer sites that treated them as synonyms of `InlineBody`/`BalancedScan`, but no producer ever constructed them; (d) three of four `strategy_*` cost knobs in `bbnf_ir::CostConfig` had zero consumers and the fourth (`strategy_dispatch_bonus`) was a numeric duplicate of `egraph::CostWeights::dispatch_bonus`. Z.5/Z.5b/Z.6 collapsed into ghost-variant deletions; Z.1/Z.3/Z.3b/Z.4/the new RefMode CSP work all deferred to Tranche AA pending profile evidence. The landed scope: Z.0 single-walk recognizer mining, Z.2 SWAR fractional digit-loop consistency fix, Z.5 + Z.5b + Z.6 cumulative ghost-variant deletion (CallStrategy::InlineFusion, WrapMode::DelimScan, four `strategy_*` knobs). Y.13 consumer-invariant test extended to cover `CallStrategy` (4 tests, was 3).
arch: Four-layer optimizer (e-graph / facts / CSP / backend) post-Z is structurally identical to post-Y modulo three further ghost-variant deletions and one walk-consolidation refactor. AltMode: 3 variants (Checkpoint / ByteDispatch / KeyDispatch) — unchanged from post-Y. WrapMode: 3 variants (Generic / SepBy / BalancedScan) — was 4 post-Y, lost DelimScan in Z.5b. CallStrategy: 2 variants (DirectCall / InlineBody) — was 3 post-Y, lost InlineFusion in Z.5. RegexEngine: unchanged (8 variants). Strategy CSP knobs: lost the four `strategy_*` fields from `bbnf_ir::CostConfig` in Z.6; the only consumer (`csp_strategy::mod`) now reads `cfg.egraph.weights.dispatch_bonus.abs()` directly — the same field the HIR-tier `RegexExtractionCost` already consumes via `hir_extraction_cost`. The universal cost model is now truly universal: one source of truth at `egraph::CostWeights`, both tiers read it. Recognizer miners: 9 independent DAG walks → 1 unified walk via the new `RecognizerMiner` trait + `RecognizerMineCtx` shared context + `MineOutputs` aggregated output struct (Z.0). Each miner is a zero-sized newtype implementing `inspect(&IrNode, NodeId, &RecognizerMineCtx, &mut MineOutputs)`. The `node_for(node)` lookup is hoisted once per node per walk (was once per miner per node — 9x reduction in hashmap accesses on small grammars).

json_canada_parse.notes: Z.2 SWAR fractional fix delivered the only measurable parse-time win in Tranche Z (~3.5% on canada). The original -12% gate assumed the larger Z.2 16-byte SIMD detection plus Z.3 single-variant inlining would land; both deferred per the corrected-scope audit (Z.1/Z.3 SIMD/inlining attempts produced no measurable improvement above the ~8% noise floor on the M-series ARM machine, indicating the LLVM-autovectorized scalar paths are already at the achievable performance ceiling for the workload). The gate is unmet but the +3.4% canada win is real and durable.

json_citm_parse.notes: Within noise (+/- 1.5%) of post-Y baseline. Z.3 single-variant inlining was deferred — the audit revealed the boxing it targets is in the BoxedEnum tuple-element-position decision, not the heterogeneous-Alt sub-variant wrapping the original audit identified. Eliminating it requires a multi-pass type-system refactor warranting Tranche AA.

json_twitter_parse.notes: Within noise. Same Z.3 deferral rationale.

css_tailwind_parse.notes: Within noise. Z.1 SIMD ws_block_comments deferred (LLVM auto-vectorizes the Y.7 LUT to ~3-4 cycles per byte; explicit NEON/SSE2 SIMD adds setup cost that is net-negative on minified-CSS short-run dominance). Z.4 dispatch-fallback consolidation deferred (multi-file dispatch-table refactor unsuitable for the Z window).

compile_css_l4.notes: Within noise (+/- 5% on the bench). Z.0 single-walk consolidation reduced the per-node hashmap-lookup count by 9x but the absolute compile-time delta is below the noise floor — the recognizer phase was not in the top-3 self-time costs of `compile_css_l4` to begin with. The refactor's value is architectural (uniform miner trait, single orchestrator walk, deletion candidate tracking) rather than wall-clock.

parse_time.description: The single landed parse-time win is Z.2's SWAR fractional digit-loop consistency fix on json_canada (+3.4% throughput). All other parse benches are within ±1.5% of post-Y, i.e. within noise. The parse-time gates assumed Z.1/Z.2/Z.3/Z.4 would all land with substantial wins — three of those four were deferred after profile / source-inspection evidence showed the targeted hot paths were already at LLVM autovectorization optima.

architectural.description: Tranche Z's primary deliverable is the cumulative ghost-variant elimination across the strategy substrate. Three previously-defined-but-never-produced variants and four ghost cost knobs were deleted, plus the Y.13 consumer-invariant test was extended to `CallStrategy` so the same drift cannot recur.
deletions: CallStrategy::InlineFusion variant + 2 consumer arms in driver/mod.rs and driver/reference.rs (Z.5)
WrapMode::DelimScan variant + 2 consumer arms in driver/wrap.rs and recognizer_plan.rs (Z.5b)
consolidations: Nine independent recognizer-miner DAG walks → one unified `walk_unified` orchestrator via the `RecognizerMiner` trait (Z.0)
Y.8 SWAR `all_eight_are_ascii_digits` helper now consumed by both the integer-digit and fractional-digit loops in scan_number_mantissa (was integer-only, Z.2)
csp_strategy/mod.rs reads `cfg.egraph.weights.dispatch_bonus.abs()` directly — the same field RegexExtractionCost already consumes via hir_extraction_cost (Z.6)
gate_details: grep -rn "pub(super) fn collect" crates/ir/src/passes/recognizers/: zero hits (Z.0 invariant)
Y.13 consumer-invariant test: 4 tests passing (added every_call_strategy_has_a_consumer)

phase_summary.title: Recognizer miner single-walk consolidation
phase_summary.impact: 9 DAG descents → 1 unified walk via RecognizerMiner trait; node_for lookup hoisted (9x reduction in hashmap accesses on small grammars); compile-time impact within noise on the M-series ARM machine but the architectural cleanup is durable

phase_summary.title: Explicit SIMD intrinsics for scan_ws_block_comments
phase_summary.impact: Three SIMD prototypes (helper-fn, inline NEON, hybrid scalar prologue + NEON bulk) all regressed tailwind ~8% above the noise floor; Y.7 LUT auto-vectorizes via LLVM and short-run dominance in minified CSS makes 16-byte SIMD setup cost net-negative. Deferred to Tranche AA pending profile evidence that scan_ws_block_comments is in the top-3 css_tailwind self-time costs

phase_summary.title: Y.8 SWAR consistency fix (fractional digit loop)
phase_summary.impact: +3.4% on json_canada parse (1,892,854 → 1,827,752 ns); citm + twitter within noise (no fractional dominance). Larger 16-byte SIMD detection deferred — same reasoning as Z.1

phase_summary.title: Single-variant enum inlining (heterogeneous Alt)
phase_summary.impact: cargo-expand of __value/__pair/__array showed Span is already inline in enum variants; the residual ~1 alloc/pair is in the BoxedEnum→Alloc tuple-position decision in decisions::child_alloc:40. Eliminating it requires propagating an InlineOK flag through ~20 BoxedEnum check sites — multi-pass type-system refactor warranting Tranche AA

phase_summary.title: Structural bitmap pre-pass (grammar-agnostic Recognizer)
phase_summary.impact: Speculative; depends on Z.3 type-system refactor. Deferred to Tranche AA

phase_summary.title: Checkpoint reduction via dispatch-fallback consolidation
phase_summary.impact: Multi-file dispatch-table refactor (generate_dispatch_tables + new AltMode variant + decide_alt_strategy gate + emit_alt_dispatch_impl + Y.13 extension) unsuitable for Z window; deferred to Tranche AA pending profile evidence the checkpoint chain is a top-3 hotspot

phase_summary.title: Delete CallStrategy::InlineFusion ghost variant
phase_summary.impact: Pivoted from full Rust→IR CSP lift (TS/WASM don't use DriverState so no cross-backend payoff). The actual ghost was CallStrategy::InlineFusion — defined and matched as a synonym of InlineBody in 2 consumer sites but never produced. Deleted variant + extended Y.13 to cover CallStrategy

phase_summary.title: Delete WrapMode::DelimScan ghost variant
phase_summary.impact: Pivoted from full new RepeatMode CSP. WrapMode::DelimScan had 0 producers, was matched as a synonym of BalancedScan in 2 consumer sites. Cumulative across Y+Z: AltMode 5→3, WrapMode 5→3, CallStrategy 3→2

phase_summary.title: Consolidate strategy cost knobs (delete duplicates + ghosts)
phase_summary.impact: 3 of 4 strategy_* knobs were ghosts (zero consumers); the 4th was a numeric duplicate of egraph::CostWeights::dispatch_bonus. Deleted all four; csp_strategy now reads cfg.egraph.weights.dispatch_bonus directly. Universal cost model achieved via single source of truth at egraph::CostWeights

tranche_length_notes: Z executed 5 phases and deferred 5; the deferral rate is much higher than Y because the original draft over-specified its scope based on a misreading of the JSON codegen + the cost-knob substrate. The corrected-scope audit was the most valuable artifact of the tranche: it identified four ghost variants/knobs that have lived in the code since W/V tranches and would have continued to drift indefinitely without an explicit producer-invariant test.

Tranche AA's scope is therefore well-defined: (1) the BoxedEnum→Enum tuple-position type-system refactor (Z.3 reframed), (2) the dispatch-fallback consolidation (Z.4 reframed), (3) profile-driven decisions on whether the deferred SIMD work (Z.1, Z.2 16-byte detection) warrants picking back up, and (4) the cross-rule CSP coupling that the Y.5 connected-components substrate enables but the current constraint topology never exercises.

The parse-time gates were missed but the architectural foundations they assumed (universal cost model, ghost-variant invariant test extension to CallStrategy) are now in place — Tranche AA can build on a cleaner substrate.
